topic: Three habits that shorten laptop battery life
title: Stop Doing This To Your Laptop Battery #siliconverdict #laptop #stopdoingthis
description: Three everyday habits that can shorten laptop battery life, and the simple habits that help instead.
pinned_comment: Heat or charge? Reply with one word.

scenes.narration: Three everyday habits quietly shorten your laptop battery life.
And the last one is the one most people miss.
First, leaving it plugged in at one hundred percent all day, every day.
Many batteries age slower when charging stops near 80 percent instead of 100.
Second, leaving it in a hot car or a stuffy backpack.
Above roughly 35 degrees Celsius, batteries can lose capacity for good.
Third, running it all the way down to zero percent again and again.
Instead, charge in the middle, keep it cool, and plug in before it runs flat.
None of this needs software, only a few small changes in how you use it.
Start with just one of them this week and see the difference.
Follow for more tech. Which habit are you changing first, heat or charge?
